required_outcomes: Records the landlord's decision to replace the machine himself and acts on it rather than continuing with the guarantee repair.

Cancels Lantern Services' return visit booked for Thursday 7 March 9-11am, telling Lantern before the visit, and confirms to them that their 28 February invoice will be paid as the landlord instructed.

Tells the tenant that Thursday's visit is cancelled and that the landlord's new washing machine is due on Friday 8 March, 7am-1pm, with the retailer texting a one-hour window, and asks him to confirm he or someone can be in or how access should be arranged.
acceptable_alternatives: Confirming the arrangements back to the landlord briefly, in addition to the messages to Lantern and the tenant.
Leaving the original invoice on hold until the agency's normal payment run, provided the landlord's instruction to pay it is recorded.
positive_behaviours: Keeps the job open, with a follow-up after Friday to confirm the new machine is installed and working before closing.
Asks the landlord or tenant to share the new machine's model and warranty details for the property record.
red_flags: Leaving Lantern's Thursday visit in place, so the provider attends a machine that is about to be replaced.
Escalating to a human when the landlord has given a clear instruction.
prohibited_actions: Telling the tenant the retailer or agency will enter without him when he has not agreed.
Closing the job before the new machine is installed.
critical_failures: Not telling the tenant about the cancelled visit and the Friday delivery, so he is left expecting Lantern on Thursday.
